keyExtra: Findings are about front-end code: unsafe DOM writes, missing escaping, a stale async response overwriting a newer one, double submit, an input without a label, focus lost after a re-render, a secret or token kept in browser storage, a listener never removed, money kept as floats. Give each item a different location (file path plus function).
brief: Phase: code review. Role: frontend developer. Repo: a static checkout front end (about 25 to 40 files: ES modules for the cart, address form, payment form, order status polling, a modal dialog, a toast helper; existing passing tests; CI; a changelog with the last few merged changes in prose, and a `docs/` folder). The request: a teammate asks for a review of the whole checkout UI before release, written to `review/REVIEW.md` with a JSON block of findings at the end. Seed 9 real defects of different kinds, 3 that look harmless at first read, and 2 decoys (an ugly but safe use of `innerHTML` with a constant string, and a large function that is well tested and low risk).
